sections.howTitle: Three steps from school leaver to your own story
sections.step1Text: A yard in Bishkek, a village in Naryn or the city centre. Every start has its own money, character and its own temptations.
sections.step2Text: Five seasons — from 17 to adulthood. A family toi, the first salary, a loan at interest: every choice moves money, energy, mood and bonds.
sections.step3Text: {count} fates — from «The Entrepreneur» to «The Mountain Soul». Between seasons the years fly: savings quietly grow, and debts never sleep.
sections.noteFinance: Financial literacy is built into the mechanics, not into lectures
sections.noteCards: 13 knowledge cards hidden inside the choices
sections.ctaTitle: So what fate will you draw?
sections.ctaText: Up to three parallel lives — check how it would have gone if you'd chosen otherwise back then. Kudai buyursa.
sections.footerTagline: A game about choices, money and life in Kyrgyzstan

about.tagline: A game about choices, money and life in Kyrgyzstan
about.intro: «Tagdyr» (Kyrgyz for «fate») is a life simulator from school leaver to grown-up. Card by card you decide: go to Issyk-Kul or save for autumn, study or work, help the family or put money aside. Small choices add up to a fate.
about.card1Text: A loan at interest, a safety cushion, compound interest — the player lives through all of it instead of reading about it.
about.card2Text: A family toi, a building site at Zhanybek's, Bishkek marshrutkas and the shore of Issyk-Kul. Situations everyone here grew up with.
about.card3Text: Live one fate as stubborn Aibek, another as quick-witted Aizhan, and compare where the roads split.
about.card4Text: 10 endings and knowledge cards hidden inside the choices. Everything unlocks by playing — no shortcuts.
about.footer: A pet project made with warmth for home. Kudai buyursa.
